claims.evidence: Witness report shows PlayStation-branded packaging and two handheld controllers, but no PS5 console is shown and the exact model/variant is not readable.
Photo 0 shows two black handheld controllers/accessories in front of the PlayStation packaging.
No game disc/cartridge/case is shown in the witness report.
The report does not include clear condition close-ups (wear, cracks, button condition, stick drift, port damage).
No internal/serial/inspection evidence is shown; witness only reports packaging and controllers.
No temperature/usage test or gameplay/benchmark clip is shown.
No ports are shown in use; no connection/pairing test is shown.
Two controllers are shown, but authenticity/originality and whether they are the exact original pads for the console are not verifiable from the report.

claims.claim: Comes with the original UK receipt
claims.evidence: No receipt/document is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: The PS5 console itself may not be included (witness only shows packaging and controllers).
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the actual PS5 console (front + back ports) and that it matches the packaging label/serial.
risks.if_unproven: Price as controllers + packaging only (no console), worst-case for buyer value.

risks.risk: Controller authenticity/model and completeness (missing cables/charging dock/manuals/extra parts).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo of everything in the box/bundle (controllers, cables, dock, manuals, game case/disc if any) with close-ups of controller model text.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used controllers only, with missing accessories assumed.

risks.risk: Controller faults: stick drift, unresponsive buttons, or charging/pairing issues.
risks.proof: A short clip showing both controllers powering on, pairing, and passing a basic input test (moving sticks, pressing all buttons) plus charging/connection indicator.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed working (worst-case: treat as needing repair/parts).

risks.risk: Console faults: overheating, fan noise, or port failures (claim not testable from photos).
risks.proof: A gameplay/boot clip showing the console running for several minutes with no shutdowns, plus a port test (HDMI/audio/USB device).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential faults (worst-case: discount heavily).

risks.risk: Game claim may be false or not included (FIFA 2025 not shown).
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the FIFA 2025 disc/case or digital receipt/license proof.

risks.risk: Authenticity/scam risk: PlayStation branding on packaging/controllers does not prove the console is genuine or that the bundle matches the words.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of serial number labels on the console (if present), controller model numbers, and matching packaging/receipt details.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest tier for used/possibly non-matching items.

proof_requests: Show the PS5 console itself (front, back ports, and power-on/boot clip).
Provide a full bundle photo: controllers, all cables, charging dock (if any), manuals, and any original box contents.
Close-up of controller model text and serial/label (both controllers).
Clip demonstrating both controllers: pairing, button presses, stick movement, and charging/connection status.
Photo/clip of FIFA 2025 (disc/case) or proof of digital ownership.
Photo of the UK receipt and any serial numbers that match the console/packaging.
response.reason: The witness confirms only PlayStation-branded packaging and two controllers; the key parts that determine value (PS5 console presence/condition, FIFA 2025 inclusion, authenticity, and working status) are not verifiable from the report. Proof is needed before a reliable worst-case price can be set.
